sn46.13:1.1: Suriyassa bhikkhave udayato etam pubbaṅgamam etam pubbanimittaṃ yadidam aruṇuggam || evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno sattannam bojjhaṅgānam uppādāya etam pubbaṅgamam etam pubbanimittaṃ yad idaṃ yonisomanasikāro || || Yonisomanasikārasampannessetam bhikkhave bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ satta bojjhaṅge bhāvessati satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkarissati || ||
sn46.13:2.1: Kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu yoniso manasikārasampanno satta bojjhaṅge bhāveti sattabojjhaṅge bahulīkaroti || || Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgam bhāveti || pe-la || upekhāsambojjhaṅgam bhāveti vivekavirāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || || Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu yonisomanasikārasampanno satta bojjhaṅge bhāveti sattabojjhaṅge bahulīkarotī ti || || Evam
